a: What you bend at the elbow
The cycle an AI agent runs: act, check the result, adjust, and go again until the job is done
In a while, as in see you ___
The amount of medicine on the label
d: What makes the fan blades spin
The color of a stop sign
n: A loop is how an agent gets work done. It takes a step, looks at what came back, adjusts, and takes the next step, over and over until the job is finished. That is why an agent can fix its own mistake halfway through a task. When you hand off a job, say what done looks like, so the loop knows when to stop.
